human_actor.identity_boundary: Attribution from the task; platform identity is not natural-person proof.

tools_and_adapters: local Python standard library and Git
artificial_cognitive_actor.identity_and_observation_limits: API-bound partial source snapshot; full current-head repository validation is required on the native runner.

human_contributions: Requested repair of PR447 local timing, binary object handling, mode/object semantics and complete end-to-end measurement boundaries.
Supplied the existing exact review-comment URL and required no distributed speedup without delivered Authority credentials and observed complete cycle.
artificial_cognitive_contributions: Reused the existing benchmark, credential resolver, fixed read-only workflow and Makefile.
Implemented raw bytes and NUL paths, Git-object SHA verification, mode/type/object/content signatures, and equivalent full/delta comparison.

Implemented separately timed fixed-subject/FETCH/comparison/sandbox reconciliation/independent remote-refetch readback cycles with alternating method order, fresh per-cycle stores and drift rejection.
Added 20 regression and cycle-boundary controls to the existing six credential tests; integrated all 26 into make test.
Prepared incrementally materialized repository integrity using unchanged source-bound manifest entries and hashes; requires fresh native full regeneration/readback.

git_history.result_head_and_tree: Bound by containing commit and fresh post-write API readback; no self-referential commit ID is embedded.

entry_identity: SHA-256 of raw blob bytes; Git object header and ID independently verified
methodology.missing_paths: Absent entry differs from an empty blob; an unreadable/corrupt object fails closed.
methodology.gitlinks: Mode/type/commit object ID are compared without requiring local submodule objects.
methodology.commit_metadata: Different commit IDs may identify different subjects with equal trees; both comparisons correctly return no file delta in that case. Reconciliation readback still requires the exact target commit.
methodology.clock_start: Before reobserving/binding the expected immutable Authority subject and Mirror base.
methodology.clock_end: After scratch-replica HEAD/TREE and all blob/mode/object verification against an independently refetched Authority store and fresh unchanged remote-head readback.
methodology.subject_route: Fixed new subject relative to the Mirror base; identical heads are HOLD_NEW_SUBJECT_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
methodology.shallow_import: Local transport of shallow source stores explicitly permits update-shallow and verifies FETCH_HEAD; a zero exit code with rejected shallow roots is not accepted.
methodology.transport_scope: Only fixed Authority/Mirror remote reads. Reconciliation CAS changes an isolated local replica; the production Mirror is never pushed or mutated.
methodology.ratio_semantics: Local and sandbox end-to-end median ratios are separate nested observations. No unscoped wall_speedup_x or distributed speedup assertion is emitted.
failure_boundaries: No Authority credential: HOLD before any remote network action and no timings/ratios.
Remote subject drift or no new subject: incomplete end-to-end trial, no end-to-end ratio.
Skipped reconciliation, bad FETCH identity, unreadable/corrupt object or result mismatch: fail closed.

regression_tests.scope: Current prepared file bytes; real isolated local Git remotes and deterministic clock controls. Not a live network Authority/Mirror measurement.
